title: 二叉树的直径
statement:
给定二叉树的根节点 root，返回树的直径：任意两个节点之间最长路径所含的边数。这条路径不一定经过根节点。

节点定义：struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }。输入中的树为 LeetCode 层序表示，null 表示空位。

en.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
en.statement:
Given the root of a binary tree, return the diameter of the tree: the number of edges on the longest path between any two nodes. This path does not necessarily pass through the root.

Node definition: struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }. The tree in the input uses LeetCode's level-order representation, where null marks an empty slot.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [1, 10^4]; -100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

complexity.space: O(h) recursion stack (or an explicit stack for iterative post-order), O(n) in the worst case.
complexity.notes: n is the number of nodes and h is the tree height. A single post-order traversal finds the maximum, over all nodes, of the sum of left and right subtree heights. The largest local test is a single chain of 10^4 nodes (recursion depth 10^4, which the default stack can handle); there are also a V-shaped double chain, a tree whose diameter does not pass through the root, and a random tree of 10^4 nodes.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is m (number of level-order tokens); line 2 has m tokens (integers or null), the tree's LeetCode level-order representation. stdout: one integer, the diameter (number of edges).

constraints: 节点数在 [1, 10^4] 范围内；-100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

complexity.space: O(h) 递归栈（或迭代后序的显式栈），最坏 O(n)。
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为节点数，h 为树高。一次后序遍历求每个节点左右子树高度之和的最大值。本地最大测试为 10^4 个节点的单链（递归深度 10^4，默认栈可承受），另含 V 形双链、直径不经过根的树与 10^4 个节点的随机树。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 m（层序 token 数）；第二行 m 个 token（整数或 null），为树的 LeetCode 层序表示。stdout：一个整数，直径（边数）。
